rounds.diagnosis: The pour subgoal region is too loose to guarantee the stream enters the mug: the height band (3–15 cm above the rim) combined with ±15 deg of spout-down tolerance and ±2 cm of lateral offset allows an end pose whose stream axis drifts several centimetres outside the mug opening. Narrowing the standoff band one step and requiring the spout direction to be tightly antiparallel to the mug's up axis keeps the pour close above the rim and aimed into the cup. The transport stage and the free roll of the pour path (the tipping DOF itself) are fine as written.
